status: Exploratory; created after prior research. No untouched evaluation period.

rule.name: Daily loser / winner
rule.explanation: Buy the stock with the weaker last-day return and short the stronger one. Recheck every close; switch only when the relative loser changes.

rule.name: Weekly relative reversal
rule.explanation: Buy the weaker stock over five sessions and short the stronger. Assess daily, hold fixed units until the direction reverses.

rule.name: Monthly relative reversal
rule.explanation: Buy the 20-session relative loser and short the winner. The model expects relative performance to reverse; the prices do not need to become equal.

rule.name: Quarterly relative reversal
rule.explanation: Use 60-session relative returns to set equal long and short legs. Review daily and switch when the relative performance gap changes sign.

rule.name: Fast ratio convergence
rule.explanation: Compare the log price ratio with its preceding 20-session average. Buy the relatively low side and short the relatively high side.

rule.name: Annual ratio convergence
rule.explanation: Trade the deviation of the log price ratio from its prior 252-session mean. Assess daily, without a cointegration gate.

rule.name: Relative trend control
rule.explanation: A control that buys the 60-session relative winner and shorts the loser. It tests persistence rather than convergence.

rule.name: Weekly loser rotation
rule.explanation: Every five sessions, invest in the weaker stock over the previous five sessions. Hold one stock, with no short leg. This carries stock-market exposure.

rule.name: Monthly loser rotation
rule.explanation: Every 20 sessions, buy the weaker performer over the previous 20 sessions. Keep holding it until a later review selects the other company. No short leg.

rule.name: Monthly trend rotation
rule.explanation: Every 20 sessions, hold the stronger stock over the previous 60 sessions. A long-only trend control with market exposure.
